name: staffpass
title: Staffpass
description: Staffpass remote MCP — AI employee control plane for Grok Bot. Fail-closed Gateway: whoami, invoke (purpose+jobId), approval status poll, health, stuck watch list/retry (badge-scoped). Confirm/send/order require human approval with explicit approvalId/statusToken/pollUrl return pipe.
notes: Public HTTPS only — no local stdio for Grok Bot Plugins / grok.com connectors.
clients should set allowed_tools to staffpass_* tools (whoami, invoke, get_approval_status, health, stuck_list, stuck_retry).
On needs_approval, poll pollUrl / staffpass_get_approval_status; do not complete confirm/send/order while pending.
